purpose: Descriptive audit of current short-horizon plan, not optimization or calibrated current win probability
signal: prior fixed close>SMA200, RSI2<=20, ret3<0; next session close>signal close, above signal SMA200 and <= signal close+.5ATR; all known by next session close

entries.delayed_open: second session open <= original signal close+.5ATR and > signal SMA200
entries.confirmed: within second through fourth session first close above first-session high; buy following open > signal SMA200 and <= first-session close+.5ATR; otherwise unfilled

exits.risk_control: net20 target (entry*1.202), fixed signal SMA200 close invalidation executed next open; third session after entry close <= first-session high => exit next open; otherwise 10th subsequent close. Open gap target uses open; intraday target uses limit. No entry-day target for conservative treatment.

embargo: shared 20-session nonoverlapping signal anchors; mature entire window within segment
secondary: 10-session high net20 touch and maximum adverse excursion, explicitly not realized profit
tests: 6 variants, no select winner to certify probability; all periods previously viewed; bootstrap block3; single current survivor; no historical afterhours fills
selection_principle: do not claim maximum win rate; recommend only if compatible with risk budget and execution; may choose no new trade
daily_cutoff: 2026-09-25 complete regular session; retrieve timestamp after16:00EDT
